<document id="disputes-status">
CheckingˆtheˆstatusˆofˆaˆdisputeˆYouˆcanˆfollowˆeveryˆdisputeˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆTapˆProfile,ˆthenˆDisputes,ˆandˆchooseˆtheˆcase.ˆ##ˆWhatˆtheˆstatusesˆmeanˆ-ˆ**Submitted:**ˆwe'veˆreceivedˆitˆandˆareˆdoingˆanˆinitialˆreview.ˆ-ˆ**Provisionalˆcreditˆissued:**ˆtheˆmoneyˆisˆbackˆinˆyourˆaccountˆwhileˆweˆinvestigate.ˆ-ˆ**Waitingˆonˆmerchant:**ˆwe'veˆcontactedˆtheˆmerchantˆthroughˆtheˆcardˆnetworkˆandˆareˆwaitingˆforˆitsˆresponse.ˆ-ˆ**Moreˆinformationˆneeded:**ˆwe'veˆaskedˆyouˆforˆsomething.ˆCheckˆyourˆmessages.ˆ-ˆ**Resolvedˆinˆyourˆfavor:**ˆtheˆcreditˆisˆpermanent.ˆ-ˆ**Denied:**ˆwe'veˆsentˆanˆexplanation,ˆandˆanyˆprovisionalˆcreditˆwillˆbeˆtakenˆback.ˆ##ˆHowˆlongˆitˆtakesˆMostˆdisputesˆfinishˆwithinˆ45ˆdays,ˆandˆsomeˆtakeˆupˆtoˆ90ˆdays.ˆWe'llˆmessageˆyouˆwheneverˆtheˆstatusˆchanges.ˆ##ˆAddingˆinformationˆYouˆcanˆuploadˆdocumentsˆorˆaddˆnotesˆtoˆanˆopenˆdisputeˆfromˆtheˆcaseˆpageˆatˆanyˆtime.ˆ##ˆCancellingˆaˆdisputeˆIfˆtheˆmerchantˆrefundsˆyouˆdirectly,ˆwithdrawˆtheˆdisputeˆfromˆtheˆcaseˆpageˆsoˆyouˆaren'tˆcreditedˆtwice.ˆIfˆyouˆwereˆcreditedˆtwice,ˆwe'llˆtakeˆbackˆtheˆextraˆamount.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="disputes-ach">
DisputingˆanˆACHˆdebitˆAnˆACHˆdebitˆisˆwhenˆaˆcompanyˆpullsˆmoneyˆfromˆyourˆaccountˆusingˆyourˆaccountˆandˆroutingˆnumber,ˆforˆexampleˆaˆutilityˆbillˆorˆaˆloanˆpayment.ˆ##ˆUnauthorizedˆACHˆdebitsˆIfˆaˆcompanyˆtookˆmoneyˆyouˆdidn'tˆauthorize,ˆreportˆitˆwithinˆ60ˆdaysˆofˆtheˆstatementˆitˆfirstˆappearedˆon.ˆTapˆtheˆtransaction,ˆthenˆGetˆhelp,ˆthenˆIˆdidn'tˆauthorizeˆthis.ˆ##ˆAuthorized,ˆbutˆwrongˆIfˆyouˆdidˆauthorizeˆtheˆcompanyˆbutˆtheˆamountˆorˆdateˆisˆwrong,ˆcontactˆtheˆcompanyˆfirst.ˆIfˆthatˆdoesn'tˆwork,ˆmessageˆsupportˆandˆwe'llˆlookˆatˆitˆwithˆyou.ˆ##ˆStoppingˆfutureˆdebitsˆYouˆcanˆblockˆaˆcompanyˆfromˆpullingˆmoneyˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆTapˆtheˆtransaction,ˆthenˆBlockˆfutureˆdebits.ˆTellˆtheˆcompanyˆtoo,ˆsoˆtheyˆknowˆtoˆbillˆyouˆanotherˆway.ˆ##ˆWhatˆhappensˆnextˆWe'llˆaskˆtheˆcompany'sˆbankˆtoˆreturnˆtheˆmoney.ˆIfˆyourˆclaimˆpassesˆanˆinitialˆreview,ˆyouˆgetˆaˆprovisionalˆcreditˆwithinˆ10ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆACHˆtransfersˆyouˆsentˆyourself,ˆandˆBrookPayˆpayments,ˆcan'tˆbeˆdisputedˆthisˆway.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="disputes-merchant-v2">
DisputingˆaˆpurchaseˆwithˆaˆmerchantˆIfˆyouˆpaidˆforˆsomethingˆwithˆyourˆcardˆandˆthere'sˆaˆproblemˆwithˆtheˆpurchaseˆitself,ˆyouˆcanˆfileˆaˆmerchantˆdispute.ˆThisˆcovers:ˆ-ˆItemsˆorˆservicesˆyouˆpaidˆforˆbutˆneverˆreceivedˆ-ˆItemsˆthatˆwereˆsignificantlyˆdifferentˆfromˆwhatˆwasˆdescribedˆ-ˆSubscriptionsˆorˆrecurringˆchargesˆthatˆcontinuedˆafterˆyouˆcancelledˆ##ˆContactˆtheˆmerchantˆfirstˆBeforeˆyouˆdispute,ˆtryˆtoˆsortˆitˆoutˆwithˆtheˆmerchant,ˆandˆkeepˆaˆrecordˆofˆwhatˆyouˆsentˆandˆwhatˆtheyˆsaid.ˆWe'llˆaskˆforˆit.ˆ##ˆHowˆlongˆyouˆhaveˆFileˆaˆmerchantˆdisputeˆwithinˆ120ˆdaysˆofˆtheˆtransactionˆdate.ˆAfterˆthat,ˆweˆcan'tˆopenˆaˆdisputeˆforˆyou.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆfileˆTapˆtheˆtransaction,ˆthenˆGetˆhelp,ˆthenˆProblemˆwithˆaˆpurchase.ˆTellˆusˆwhatˆhappenedˆandˆuploadˆyourˆrecords.ˆ##ˆWhatˆhappensˆnextˆIfˆtheˆdisputeˆpassesˆanˆinitialˆreview,ˆyouˆgetˆaˆprovisionalˆcreditˆwithinˆ10ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆWeˆthenˆcontactˆtheˆmerchantˆthroughˆtheˆcardˆnetwork.ˆMostˆcasesˆfinishˆwithinˆ45ˆdays.ˆTransactionsˆyouˆdon'tˆrecognizeˆatˆallˆareˆaˆdifferentˆkindˆofˆdispute.ˆSeeˆ"Disputingˆaˆtransactionˆyouˆdidn'tˆmake".ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>
